[EN] I've been with the Mysterium contingent since I was a tyro. I've never seen Mattin scared. Elthim either.

They look across this valley, at those ruins, and I see longing and terror in their faces.
[ES] He estado con el contingente del Mysterium desde que era un novato. Nunca he visto a Mattin asustado. Ni a Elthim.

Mirizan este valle, esas ruinas, y veo anhelo y terror en sus rostros.
